<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const sidebar = document.querySelector("#quarto-sidebar .sidebar-menu-container > ul");
  const categories = document.querySelector("#quarto-margin-sidebar .quarto-listing-category");

  if (!sidebar || !categories) return;

  const categoryItem = document.createElement("li");
  categoryItem.className = "sidebar-item";
  categoryItem.append(categories);
  sidebar.replaceChildren(categoryItem);

  document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category-title")?.remove();
});
</script>
